text: 任务通知台 · Task Notifier（DSH Web 插件）：帮助用户及时发现已完成或需要本人处理的会话。它在 DSH 侧栏注册任务面板，由宿主跟踪会话状态、浏览器端刷新显示。用户可筛选待回复、运行中和已完成未读任务，搜索标题、打开会话并标记已读。任务完成时可播放提示音并发送浏览器通知；macOS 也可用系统通知。未读状态保存在本机 DSH 存储目录，无需 API Key 或外部账号。

Task Notifier adds a DSH sidebar panel for tracking running, waiting, and completed unread sessions. Search titles, reopen sessions, and mark tasks read. Task completion can trigger a chime and browser notification; macOS system notifications are also supported. Unread status is stored locally.
想在 DSH 侧栏集中查看哪些会话还在运行、哪些已经完成。
DSH 任务跑完时能不能提醒我，并让我快速回到对应会话？
I want a sidebar list of DSH sessions waiting for my reply or approval.
任务状态面板：在 DSH 侧栏打开面板，按待回复、已完成未读、运行中、已完成或全部筛选任务，并可按标题搜索和进入对应会话。
任务完成提醒：任务结束时可播放浏览器合成提示音，并通过浏览器或 macOS 系统通知提醒用户。

@polunzh/dsh-task-notifier README · 中文：> DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web 插件：**任务完成时提醒你**，并给你一个能筛选「待回复 / 已完成未读」的任务面板。

@polunzh/dsh-task-notifier README · 它解决什么：DSH 跑长任务时，你切走去干别的，回来才发现早就跑完了。这个插件把「完成」这件事推到你能看到的地方：

- **提示音**：任意会话一轮结束，浏览器合成一段上行 chime（G5→C6），不需要音频素材。
- **通知双通道**：
  - 页面开着且已授权 → 浏览器 `Notification`，点一下跳回对应会话；
  - 页面关了或未授权 → 宿主在 macOS 上弹系统通知（`osascript`），不会双弹（心跳判重）。
- **待回复状态**：Agent 向你提问、等你审阅计划或等你审批时，侧栏图标亮起琥珀色脉冲点，面板新增「待回复」分类，点开直接回到那个等你决定的会话。
- **任务面板**：侧边栏图标（带未读角标）→ 五个筛选：**待回复 / 已完成未读 / 运行中 / 已完成 / 全部**，支持按标题搜索、全部标为已读、试听提示音、试发系统通知。
- **未读不丢**：状态写在 `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-task-notifier/state.json`，重启后还在。
- **中英双语**：界面与系统通知文案跟随宿主语言（zh / en）。

@polunzh/dsh-task-notifier README · 安装：**方式一：开放插件市场安装**（推荐，可在市场点赞）

已收录进社区市场（分类「工作流与协作」，已通过源码级验证 ✅）：在「插件 → 实验性插件」打开「自定义插件市场」→ **发现 → 添加索引源**，粘贴：

```
https://dshopen.org/index.json
```

之后搜索「任务通知台 / Task Notifier」安装；市场页与点赞见 [dshopen 插件页](https://dshopen.org/zh/plugins/@polunzh/dsh-task-notifier/)。

**方式二：从自建索引安装**（可自动检测更新）

同样在「发现 → 添加索引源」粘贴：

```
https://dsh.127.dev/index.json
```

之后搜索「任务通知台 / Task Notifier」安装；有新版本时列表会显示可更新，卸载在「已安装」里。
索引每 6 小时随 npm 刷新，源码见 [dsh-plugins-index](https://github.com/polunzh/dsh-plugins-index)。

@polunzh/dsh-task-notifier README · 安装：**方式三：npm 安装**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @polunzh/dsh-task-notifier
```

**方式四：从本地目录安装**（开发调试）

在 DSH 里用 `plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle`，`target` 填本仓库的绝对路径。

@polunzh/dsh-task-notifier README · 配置：全部可省略，写在你的 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: polunzh-task-notifier
      name: '@polunzh/dsh-task-notifier'
      config:

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `osNotify` | `auto` | `auto`=页面在线交给浏览器通知、离线兜底系统通知；`always`=恒发系统通知；`off`=不发 |
| `sound` | `true` | 浏览器合成提示音 |
| `osSound` | `Glass` | macOS 自带提示音名（Glass / Ping / Pop …） |
| `osTitle` | `DeepSeek Harness` | 系统通知标题 |

@polunzh/dsh-task-notifier README · 隐私与安全：- **不联网**：没有任何出站请求、遥测或远程资源。
- **不上传**：会话标题只写本机 `state.json`，目录 0700、文件 0600。
- **不读凭据**：不碰 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`、`.env`、keychain、SSH key。
- **路由 fail-closed**：宿主连接守卫缺失时直接拒绝，不做"没守卫就放行"。
- **无安装期脚本**：`package.json` 里没有 `preinstall/postinstall/prepare`。

细节、威胁模型与限流参数见 [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md)。

@polunzh/dsh-task-notifier README · English：> A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web plugin that **notifies you when a task finishes** and gives you a Tasks panel that surfaces sessions waiting on your input alongside completed-but-unread ones.
@polunzh/dsh-task-notifier README · What it solves：Long-running DSH sessions finish while you are looking somewhere else. This plugin pushes "done" to where you can see it:

@polunzh/dsh-task-notifier README · What it solves：- **Chime** — when any session's turn ends, the browser synthesizes a short ascending chime (G5→C6); no audio assets needed.
- **Two notification channels**:
  - Page open and permission granted → browser `Notification`; clicking it jumps back to that session.
  - Page closed or permission not granted → the host raises a macOS system notification (`osascript`). A heartbeat keeps the two channels from double-firing.
- **Needs-input state** — when an agent asks you a question, waits for a plan review, or waits on an approval, the sidebar icon shows an amber pulsing dot and the panel gains a **Needs input** filter, so you can jump straight to the session that is blocked on you.
- **Tasks panel** — a sidebar icon with an unread badge and five filters: **needs input / unread / running / completed / all**, plus title search, mark-all-read, preview the chime and send a test notification.
- **Unread survives restarts** — state lives in `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-task-notifier/state.json`.
- **Bilingual UI** — interface and system-notification text follow the host language (zh / en).

@polunzh/dsh-task-notifier README · Install：**Option 1 — via the Open Plugin Market (recommended; supports likes)

Listed on the community market (category "workflow", source-verified ✅). In DSH: **Plugins → Experimental plugins** → enable **Custom plugin markets** → **Discover → Add index source**, then paste:

```
https://dshopen.org/index.json
```

Search for "任务通知台 / Task Notifier" and install. Market page: [dshopen plugin page](https://dshopen.org/zh/plugins/@polunzh/dsh-task-notifier/).

@polunzh/dsh-task-notifier README · Install：**Option 2 — via the self-hosted index (tracks updates)**

In DSH: **Plugins → Experimental plugins** → enable **Custom plugin markets** → **Discover → Add index source**, then paste:

```
https://dsh.127.dev/index.json
```

Search for "任务通知台 / Task Notifier" and install. New versions show as update-available; uninstall from **Installed**.
The index refreshes from npm every 6 hours — source at [dsh-plugins-index](https://github.com/polunzh/dsh-plugins-index).

**Option 3 — npm**

@polunzh/dsh-task-notifier README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @polunzh/dsh-task-notifier
```

**Option 4 — from a local checkout (development)**

Use `plugin_manager` with `install_bundle` and point `target` at this repository's absolute path.

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: polunzh-task-notifier
      name: '@polunzh/dsh-task-notifier'
      config:

@polunzh/dsh-task-notifier README · Configuration：| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `osNotify` | `auto` | `auto` = browser notification while the page is live, system notification otherwise; `always` = always system notification; `off` = none |
| `sound` | `true` | Browser-synthesized chime |
| `osSound` | `Glass` | A built-in macOS sound name (Glass / Ping / Pop …) |
| `osTitle` | `DeepSeek Harness` | System notification title |

@polunzh/dsh-task-notifier README · Privacy and security：- **No network**: no outbound requests, telemetry or remote assets.
- **No uploads**: session titles are written only to the local `state.json` (directory `0700`, file `0600`).
- **No credential reads**: never touches `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`, `.env`, keychain or SSH keys.
- **Fail-closed routing**: if the host connection guard is unavailable, requests are rejected instead of allowed.
- **No install-time scripts**: no `preinstall` / `postinstall` / `prepare` in `package.json`.
@polunzh/dsh-task-notifier README · Privacy and security：Threat model, limits and rate limits are documented in [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md).

@polunzh/dsh-task-notifier README · Upgrading from 1.1.0 / coexistence：Since 1.1.1 the browser module id is the package name (`@polunzh/dsh-task-notifier`) and the patch row id is
`polunzh-task-notifier`, so a different plugin that happens to share the old ids can no longer break DSH's boot.
If you previously installed a `link:` copy or an older version, **keep only one**: uninstall the old entry from
**Plugins → Installed** first, then install 1.1.1.

@polunzh/dsh-task-notifier README · Compatibility：| Item | Requirement |
|---|---|
| DSH | `>=0.2.0-rc.2` (declared in `engines.dsh`) |
| Node | `>=20` |
| Platform | Any platform for the web UI; **system notifications are macOS-only**, other platforms get browser notifications |
| Browser notifications | Require an explicit user gesture (the plugin never prompts in the background) |

@polunzh/dsh-task-notifier README · Privacy and security：- **No network**: no outbound requests, telemetry or remote assets.
- **No uploads**: session titles are written only to the local `state.json` (directory `0700`, file `0600`).
- **No credential reads**: never touches `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`, `.env`, keychain or SSH keys.
- **Fail-closed routing**: if the host connection guard is unavailable, requests are rejected instead of allowed.
- **No install-time scripts**: no `preinstall` / `postinstall` / `prepare` in `package.json`.
@polunzh/dsh-task-notifier README · Privacy and security：Threat model, limits and rate limits are documented in [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md).

@polunzh/dsh-task-notifier README · Upgrading from 1.1.0 / coexistence：Since 1.1.1 the browser module id is the package name (`@polunzh/dsh-task-notifier`) and the patch row id is
`polunzh-task-notifier`, so a different plugin that happens to share the old ids can no longer break DSH's boot.
If you previously installed a `link:` copy or an older version, **keep only one**: uninstall the old entry from
**Plugins → Installed** first, then install 1.1.1.
